description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The user's application ID, generated when creating an application in the console. Contains lowercase letters and digits, with a length of 6 characters.

description.zh: 自定义消息体的内容，大小不超过2048个字节。
description.en: The content of the custom message body, with a maximum size of 2048 bytes.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when calling CreateRoom.
